question: How is near-far difference manifested for swift-moving things?
premises: because of prior light of swift-moving things
difference by near and far is manifested
inference: The verse explains near-far difference through prior light of swift-moving things.
uncertainties: reading of pūrvakatejasām and parenthetical mark
plain_english: Because of prior light of swift-moving things, difference by near and far is manifested.
